title: Privacy Policy
html:
Unless otherwise stated below, the provision of your personal data is neither legally nor contractually required, nor is it a prerequisite for entering into a contract. You are not obligated to provide your data. Failure to provide it will have no consequences. This applies only as long as nothing else is specified in the following processing procedures.

“Personal data” means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

Server log files

You can use our websites without providing any personal data.

Each time you access our website, user data is transmitted from your internet browser to us or our web host/IT service provider and stored in server log files. This stored data includes, for example, the name of the page accessed, the date and time of the request, the IP address, the amount of data transferred, and the requesting provider. This processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR due to our legitimate interest in the smooth operation of our website and the improvement of our services.

Contact

Responsible person

Please contact us at any time. The data controller is: ASSCA GmbH, Heinrich-Hertz-Str. 28, 78052 Villingen-Schwenningen, Germany, +49(0)7721 6809150, info@astano.de

Proactive contact via email

If you proactively contact us by email, we collect your personal data (name, email address, message text) only to the extent you specify. The purpose of data processing is to process and respond to your contact request.

If the contact is for the purpose of carrying out pre-contractual measures (e.g., advice regarding purchase interest, order placement) or relates to a contract already concluded between you and us, this data processing is carried out on the basis of Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR.

If you contact us for other reasons, this data processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, in order to protect our overriding legitimate interest in processing and responding to your inquiry. In this case, you have the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, at any time to the processing of your personal data pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

We use your email address solely for processing your request. Your data will then be deleted in accordance with statutory retention periods, unless you have consented to further processing and use.

.

Data collection and processing when using the contact form

When you use the contact form, we collect your personal data (name, email address, message text) only to the extent that you specify. The data is processed solely for the purpose of contacting you.

If the contact is for the purpose of carrying out pre-contractual measures (e.g., providing advice regarding a potential purchase, placing an order) or relates to a contract already concluded between you and us, this data processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. If the contact is for other reasons, this data processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR to protect our overriding legitimate interest in processing and responding to your inquiry. In this case, you have the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, at any time to the processing of your personal data pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

We use your email address solely for processing your request. Your data will then be deleted unless you have consented to further processing and use.

Capture and processing when sending images via upload

We offer an image file upload function on our website. This allows you to send us encrypted images. When you submit your images, we collect your personal data (an image of an identifiable person) only to the extent you specify. The purpose of this data processing is to create personalized products. The submitted image serves as a template for the product and is used for this purpose (e.g., for T-shirt printing). This processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and is necessary for the performance of a contract with you. Your data will not be shared with third parties.

We use the image you send us solely for the purpose of providing our services. Your data will then be deleted, subject to statutory retention periods, unless you have consented to further processing and use.

Capture and processing of images sent via email

You have the option of sending us images via email in connection with ordering a personalized product.

By submitting your images, we collect your personal data (image of an identifiable person) only to the extent you specify. The purpose of data processing is the creation of personalized products. The submitted image serves as a template for the product and is used for this purpose (e.g., for T-shirt printing). Processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and is necessary for the performance of a contract with you.

Your data will not be transferred.

We use the image you send us solely for the purpose of providing our services. Your data will then be deleted, subject to statutory retention periods, unless you have consented to further processing and use.

Using WeTransfer

We use the WeTransfer service provided by WeTransfer B.V. (Willem Fenengastraat 19, 1096 BL Amsterdam, Netherlands; "WeTransfer") to send you files up to 2 GB in size upon request.

This service is for transferring large files in high quality. To do this, we send your email address and the file to be transferred to WeTransfer. WeTransfer generates a download link, which is sent to you and us via email. The data is encrypted by WeTransfer during transfer and storage and is only accessible via the download link.

Your personal data may be transferred to WeTransfer servers in the USA and temporarily stored there (partially unencrypted). The EU Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the USA, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TADPF). WeTransfer is not certified under the TADPF. Data transfers are based, among other things, on standard contractual clauses as appropriate safeguards for the protection of personal data. These can be viewed at the following link: https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/international-dimension-data-protection/standard-contractual-clauses-scc_de

The processing is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR with your consent, provided you have expressly agreed to the use of WeTransfer.

You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us. The lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent until its withdrawal remains unaffected.

Further information on data protection when using WeTransfer can be found at: https://wetransfer.com/legal/privacy (https://wetransfer.com/legal/privacy).

Customer account orders

Customer account

When you create a customer account, we collect your personal data to the extent specified there. This data processing serves to improve your shopping experience and simplify order processing. The processing is based on Article 6(1)(a) GDPR with your consent. You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us. The lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent until its withdrawal remains unaffected. Your customer account will then be deleted.

Your data will be shared with, for example, shipping companies, dropshipping or fulfillment providers, payment service providers, order processing service providers, and IT service providers. We strictly adhere to all legal regulations in every case. The scope of data transfer is limited to the minimum necessary.

Reviews advertising

Review reminder

After placing your order, we would like to ask you to rate your purchase with us.

For this purpose, we use your personal data (name, email address, order information) independently of the contract processing to send you a reminder by email after an order for verification, provided you have expressly agreed to this.

The processing is based on Article 6(1)(a) GDPR with your consent. You can withdraw your consent at any time via the corresponding link in the email or by sending us a message, without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent before its withdrawal.

Use of your personal data for sending postal advertising

We use your personal data (name, address), which we received in connection with the sale of goods or services, to send you postal advertising, unless you have objected to this use. Providing this data is necessary for the conclusion of the contract. Without this data, a contract cannot be concluded.

Your data is processed on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR due to our legitimate interest in direct marketing. You can object to this use of your address data at any time by contacting us. Contact details for exercising your right to object can be found in our legal notice.

Verwendung Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse für den Versand von Newslettern

We use your email address outside of contract processing solely for sending our newsletter for our own marketing purposes, provided you have expressly consented to this. This processing is based on Article 6(1)(a) GDPR with your consent. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time via the corresponding link in the newsletter or by contacting us. Your email address will then be removed from our mailing list.

Use of your email address for sending direct marketing emails

We use your email address, which we obtained in connection with the sale of goods or services, to send you electronic advertising for our own similar goods or services, unless you have objected to this use. Providing your email address is necessary for the conclusion of the contract. Without this information, a contract cannot be concluded. This processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR due to our legitimate interest in direct marketing. You can object to the use of your email address at any time by contacting us. Our contact details for exercising your right to object can be found in our legal notice. Alternatively, you can use the unsubscribe link included in the advertising email. Only standard transmission costs will apply.

Using CleverReach

We use the services of CleverReach GmbH & Co. KG (Schafjückenweg 2, 26180 Rastede; "CleverReach") for order processing.

We forward the data you provided when subscribing to our newsletter (email address, first and last name, if applicable) to CleverReach. This data processing is used for sending the newsletter and for statistical analysis of its content.

To evaluate our newsletter campaigns, the newsletters we send contain a 1x1 pixel graphic (tracking pixel) or a tracking link. This allows us to determine whether you have opened the newsletter and clicked on one of the links it contains. Using conversion tracking, we analyze, for example, whether a purchase was made or a registration on our website occurred after clicking a link in the newsletter. In this context, we collect your personal data such as IP address, browser type, device, and the time of access. A pseudonymized user profile can be created from this data. The collected data is not used to personally identify you. It serves exclusively for statistical analysis to optimize our newsletter campaigns.

Your personal data is processed on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR due to our overriding legitimate interest in targeted, effective advertising and a user-friendly newsletter system. You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation.

Further information and Cleverreach's privacy policy can be found at: https://www.cleverreach.com/de-de/datenschutz/ (https://www.cleverreach.com/de-de/datenschutz/) and https://www.cleverreach.com/de-de/newsletter-tool/newsletter-reporting/ (https://www.cleverreach.com/de-de/newsletter-tool/newsletter-reporting/).

Use of Rapidmail

For sending newsletters as part of order processing, we use the service of rapidmail GmbH (Wentzingerstraße 21, 79106 Freiburg im Breisgau; "rapidmail").

Wir leiten die von Ihnen bei der Newsletter-Anmeldung angegebenen Daten (E-Mail-Adresse, ggf. Vor- und Nachname) an rapidmail weiter. Die Datenverarbeitung dient dem Versand des Newsletters und dessen statistischer Auswertung.

To evaluate our newsletter campaigns, the newsletters we send contain a 1x1 pixel tracking pixel or a tracking link. This allows us to determine whether you have opened the newsletter and clicked on the links it contains. In this context, we collect your personal data such as IP address, browser type, device, and time. A pseudonymized user profile can be created from this data. The collected data is not used to personally identify you. It serves solely for statistical analysis to optimize our newsletter campaigns.

Your personal data is processed on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR due to our overriding legitimate interest in targeted, effective advertising and a user-friendly newsletter system. You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation.

Further information and rapidMail's privacy policy can be found at: https://www.rapidmail.de/datenschutz (https://www.rapidmail.de/datenschutz) and https://www.rapidmail.de/hilfe/kategorie/statistiken (https://www.rapidmail.de/hilfe/kategorie/statistiken).

Using Mailchimp

We use the service of Rocket Science Group LLC (675 Ponce de Leon Ave NE, Suite 5000 Atlanta, GA 30308, USA; "Mailchimp") for sending newsletters as part of order processing.

The data you provide when subscribing to the newsletter (email address, and optionally first and last name) will be forwarded to Mailchimp. This data processing is used for sending the newsletter and for statistical analysis of its distribution.

To evaluate our newsletter campaigns, the newsletters we send contain a 1x1 pixel tracking pixel or a tracking link. This allows us to determine whether you have opened the newsletter and clicked on the links it contains. In this context, we collect your personal data such as IP address, browser type, device, and time. A pseudonymized user profile can be created from this data. The collected data is not used to personally identify you. It serves solely for statistical analysis to optimize our newsletter campaigns.

The data processing serves the purpose of sending the newsletter and its statistical analysis. Your data is generally transferred to and stored on Mailchimp servers in the USA. The EU Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the USA, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TAPF). Mailchimp is not certified under the TAPF. The data transfer is based, among other things, on standard contractual clauses as suitable safeguards for the protection of personal data. You can view these here: https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/international-dimension-data-protection/standard-contractual-clauses-scc_de (https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/data-protection/international-dimension-data-protection/standard-contractual-clauses-scc_de).

Your personal data is processed on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR due to our overriding legitimate interest in targeted, effective advertising and a user-friendly newsletter system. You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation.

Further information and MailChimp's privacy policy can be found at: https://mailchimp.com/de/legal/data-processing-addendum/ (https://mailchimp.com/de/legal/data-processing-addendum/) and https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/ (https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/).

Shipping company goods management

Forwarding your email address to shipping companies to inform you about the shipping status

Forwarding your email address to the shipping company: We forward your email address to the shipping company as part of the order processing, provided you have expressly consented to this during the ordering process. This forwarding is for the purpose of informing you about the shipping status of your order via email. The processing is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR with your consent. You can revoke your consent at any time by contacting us or the shipping company. The lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent until revocation remains unaffected.

Use of an external merchandise management system

As part of our order processing, we use an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system for contract fulfillment. For this purpose, your personal data collected during the ordering process will be transmitted to Buhl Mein Büro.

Payment service provider

Use of PayPal

On our website, we use the payment service PayPal from PayPal (Europe) S.à.r.l. et Cie, S.C.A. (22-24 Boulevard Royal, L-2449 Luxembourg; "PayPal"). The data processing serves to enable you to pay via this service. If you select and use PayPal as your payment method, the data required for payment processing will be transmitted to PayPal so that we can fulfill the contract with you using the selected payment method. This processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.

All PayPal transactions are subject to the PayPal Privacy Policy. You can find it at https://www.paypal.com/de/webapps/mpp/ua/privacy-full.

Cookies

Our website uses cookies. Cookies are small text files that are stored in or by a user's web browser on their computer system. When a website is accessed, a cookie can be stored on the user's operating system. This cookie contains a unique string of characters that allows the browser to be uniquely identified when the website is accessed again.

Cookies are stored on your computer. You therefore have full control over their use. By adjusting your internet browser settings, you can be notified before cookies are set and decide on a case-by-case basis whether to accept them or prevent the storage of cookies and the transmission of the data they contain. Cookies that have already been stored can be deleted at any time. However, please note that this may prevent you from using all the functions of this website. The following links explain how to manage (or disable) cookies in common browsers: Chrome: https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/61416?hl=en (https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/61416?hl=en) Microsoft Edge: https://support.microsoft.com/de-de/microsoft-edge/cookies-in-microsoft-edge-lB6schen-63947406-40ac-c3b8-57b9-2a946a29ae09 (https://support.microsoft.com/de-de/microsoft-edge/cookies-in-microsoft-edge-lB6schen-63947406-40ac-c3b8-57b9-2a946a29ae09) Mozilla Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/enable-and-disable-cookies-website-preferences (https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/enable-and-disable-cookies-website-preferences) Safari: https://support.apple.com/de-de/guide/safari/manage-cookies-and-website-data-sfri11471/mac (https://support.apple.com/de-de/guide/safari/manage-cookies-and-website-data-sfri11471/mac)

Pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, you have the right to object, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to this processing of your personal data.

Advertising tracking

Using the conversion tracking feature of Google Ads

Unsere Website nutzt das Online-Marketingprogramm „Google Ads“ inklusive Conversion-Tracking (Auswertung von Nutzeraktionen). Google Conversion-Tracking ist ein Dienst der Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Irland; „Google“).

When you click on ads served by Google, a conversion tracking cookie is stored on your computer. These cookies have a limited lifespan, do not contain any personally identifiable information, and therefore cannot be used for personal identification. If you visit certain pages of our website and the cookie has not yet expired, we and Google can recognize that you clicked on the ad and were redirected to this page. Each Google Ads customer receives a unique cookie. Therefore, it is not possible to track cookies associated with the websites of different Ads customers.

The information collected using the conversion cookie is used to generate conversion statistics. This allows us to determine the total number of users who clicked on our ads and were redirected to a page with a conversion tracking tag. However, no information is collected that could be used to personally identify users. Your data may be transferred to servers of Google LLC in the USA. The EU Commission's adequacy decision, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TADPF), applies to the USA. Google has been certified under TADPF and has thus committed to complying with European data protection principles.

The use of cookies or similar technologies is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 25 para. 1 sentence 1 TDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. The processing of your personal data is also based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent before its withdrawal.

Further information and Google's privacy policy can be found at: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/ (https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/)

Use of the remarketing or "similar audiences" function of Google Inc.

Our website uses the remarketing or "similar audiences" feature of Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland; "Google").

This application is used to analyze visitor behavior and visitor interests.

Google uses cookies to analyze website usage and deliver interest-based advertising. Cookies enable the collection of website visits and anonymized usage data. No personal data of website visitors is stored. When you subsequently visit another website in the Google Display Network, you will see ads that reflect your previous product and information interests.

Your data may be transferred to servers of Google LLC in the USA. The EU Commission's adequacy decision, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TADPF), applies to the USA. Google has been certified under TADPF and has thus committed to complying with European data protection principles.

The use of cookies or similar technologies is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 25 para. 1 sentence 1 TDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. The processing of your personal data is also based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent before its withdrawal.

More detailed information about Google Remarketing and the associated privacy policy can be found at: https://www.google.com/privacy/ads/ (https://www.google.com/privacy/ads/)

Plugins

Detailed information about Google Remarketing and the associated privacy policy can be found at: https://www.google.com/privacy/ads/ (https://www.google.com/privacy/ads/)

Our website uses the YouTube video embedding function provided by Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland; "YouTube"). YouTube is a company affiliated with Google LLC (1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA; "Google").

This feature displays YouTube videos in an iFrame on the website. "Enhanced Privacy Mode" is enabled. This prevents YouTube from storing information about website visitors. Information is only transmitted to and stored by YouTube when you watch a video. Your data may be transferred to the USA. The EU Commission's adequacy decision, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TADPF), applies to the USA. YouTube has been certified under TADPF and has thus committed to complying with European data protection principles.

The use of cookies or similar technologies is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 25 para. 1 sentence 1 TDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. The processing of your personal data is also based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent before its withdrawal.

Weitere Informationen über die von YouTube und Google erhobenen und verwendeten Daten sowie Ihre damit verbundenen Rechte und Möglichkeiten zum Schutz Ihrer Privatsphäre finden Sie in der Datenschutzerklärung von YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/t/privacy (https://www.youtube.com/t/privacy)).

Integration of the Händlerbund member logo

The logo of the German Retail Federation (Händlerbund e.V., Kohlgartenstraße 11–13, 04315 Leipzig) is integrated into our website. When you visit our website, your device's browser automatically sends information to the server of the German Retail Federation (Händlerbund e.V.). This information is temporarily stored in a server log file for 7 days. The following information is collected automatically and stored until it is automatically deleted:

- IP address of the requesting computer,

- Date and time of access,

- Name and URL of the accessed file,

- Website from which access was made (referrer URL).

We collect the browser you are using, your computer's operating system (if applicable), and the name of your internet service provider. The temporary storage of your IP address by the system is necessary to provide the website. For this purpose, the IP address must be stored for the duration of your session. The data is stored in log files to ensure the website's functionality. Furthermore, the data is used to optimize the website and to guarantee the security of our IT systems. This data is not combined with other personal data. The legal basis for this data processing is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Use of Google FontsA

We use Google Fonts from Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland; "Google") on our website.

The data processing serves to ensure the consistent display of fonts on our website. To load the fonts, a connection is established to Google servers when the page is accessed. This involves processing and transmitting your IP address and information about your browser to Google. This data is not linked to your Google account. Your data may be transferred to the USA. The EU Commission's adequacy decision, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TASPF), applies to the USA. Google has been certified under TAPF and has thus committed to complying with European data protection principles.

The use of cookies or similar technologies is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 25 para. 1 sentence 1 TDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. The processing of your personal data is also based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out based on your consent before its withdrawal.

More detailed information on data processing and data protection can be found at https://www.google.de/intl/de/policies/ and at https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq.

Verwenden von Font Awesome

We use Font Awesome from Fonticons Inc. (307 S Main St., Suite 202, Bentonville, AR, 72712-9214 USA "Font Awesome") on our website. The data processing serves to ensure the consistent display of fonts and icons on our website. A connection to the Font Awesome servers is established when the page is accessed to load the fonts.

Cookies may be used for this purpose. Among other things, your IP address and information about your browser will be processed and transmitted to Font Awesome. Your data may be transferred to third countries, such as the USA. The EU Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the USA, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TADPF). Font Awesome is not certified under the TADPF. The use of cookies or similar technologies is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 25 para. 1 sentence 1 TDDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. The processing of your personal data is also based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. Further information on data processing and data protection can be found at https://fontawesome.com/privacy and at https://fontawesome.com/support.

Verwendung von Google Translate

We use the translation service of Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) on our website via an API integration. This data processing serves to display website information in another language. To ensure the translation is displayed automatically after selecting a language, your browser establishes a connection to Google's servers. Cookies may be used for this purpose. The following information, among other things, may be collected and processed: IP address, URL of the visited page, date and time. Your data may be transferred to the USA. The EU Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the USA, the Transatlantic Data Protection Framework (TADPF). Google has been certified under the TADPF and has thus committed to complying with European data protection principles.

The use of cookies or similar technologies is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 25 para. 1 sentence 1 TDDG in conjunction with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. The processing of your personal data is also based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. Further information on the collection and use of your data by Google can be found at: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/ (https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/).

Rechte der Betroffenen und Speicherdauer

Duration of storage

After completion of the contractual processing, the data will initially be stored for the duration of the warranty period, then in accordance with the legally prescribed retention periods, in particular those under tax and commercial law, and deleted after these periods have expired, unless you have consented to further processing and use.

Rights of the data subject

Provided the legal requirements are met, you have the following rights under Articles 15 to 20 of the GDPR: the right to information, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and data portability. You also have the right to object to the processing of your data pursuant to Article 6(1) of the GDPR and to the processing of your data for direct marketing purposes pursuant to Article 21(1) of the GDPR.

Right to lodge a complaint with the regulatory authority

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority pursuant to Article 77 GDPR if you believe that your data is not being processed lawfully.

Widerspruchsrecht

If the data processing described here is based on our legitimate interests pursuant to Article 6 paragraph 1 letter f) GDPR, you have the right to object to the processing of your data at any time with effect for the future on grounds relating to your particular situation.

If the objection is upheld, we will no longer process the personal data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds for the processing which override your interests or rights and freedoms, or the processing serves the purpose of establishing, exercising or defending legal claims.

If your personal data is processed for direct marketing purposes, you can object to this at any time by informing us. In the event of a successful objection, we will no longer process your personal data for direct marketing purposes.
